summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the analytics platform's version number. The current version (v0.14.14) was deemed outdated, and a move to a more structured versioning system was proposed.

Multiple suggestions were made for new version formats, including v[year].[major_release_num].[minor_release_num] and simpler year-based structures. After discussion, the team agreed on using **v2023.1.0** as the official version number.

A release date was also discussed; while one participant suggested releasing immediately (Friday), others recommended waiting until Monday to allow time for final fixes.
decisions: The new analytics version will be v2023.1.0.
The planned release date is set for Monday.
action_items: Wait for the last fix from Alex before releasing.
